title: Median/Right of Way Maintenance
description: Use this service request type to report routine maintenance of shrubs, trees, trimming and mowing on City of Dallas medians or rights-of-way (median, triangles, and traffic circles). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Maintenance = Other; location = Street; direction = Other

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for routine mowing, trimming, or tree removal on City medians or rights-of-way.
actions.why: For routine mowing, shrub trimming, tree trimming or removal, or other maintenance on City medians or rights-of-way such as medians, triangles, and traffic circles. The request form asks maintenance type, location (highway right-of-way, median, sidewalk, or street), and direction of travel.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Median/Right of Way Maintenance"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Median/Right of Way Maintenance"
